summary: San Francisco Bay Area resident, software engineer with experience in startups, strong libertarian beliefs, interest in technology and programming (especially in languages like Ruby and Go), frequent discussions on social and political issues, skepticism towards unions, critical of police and government authority, engaged in discussions about healthcare access and quality, enjoys reading and discussing science fiction, has lived in multiple cities including London and Mumbai, values personal freedom and individualism, critical of mainstream media narratives, and has a strong interest in open-source software and technology innovation.
